meta.name: hyperframes-core
meta.description: The HyperFrames composition contract — build one renderable project. Use for composition structure, the `data-*` timing attributes, `class="clip"`, tracks, sub-compositions, variables, framework-owned media playback, deterministic-render rules, and validation. Read before writing composition HTML.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建可渲染的画面合成项目,用时间轴排好片段并校验输出。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做逐帧可复现的媒体合成并需要校验。
copy.tagline_en: Build renderable composition projects with clips, tracks, and validated output.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble frame-accurate compositions and need deterministic, validated renders.

howto.what: Claude 会按 HyperFrames 的合成契约写出可渲染成视频的 HTML 工程：用 data-* 声明时序、class="clip" 标记片段，并遵守轨道、子合成、变量与确定性渲染规则。
howto.when: 在动手写合成 HTML 前，或涉及合成结构、“data-*”时序属性、轨道等话题，以及校验已有工程时接管。

say.text: 帮我从最小合成骨架开始写一个可渲染的 HyperFrames 工程
say.note: 会给出最小可渲染的合成骨架

say.text: 检查我的 index.html 有哪些 lint 报错，告诉我怎么改
say.note: 逐条列出 lint 报错与改法

say.text: 用 npx hyperframes timeline 列出这个工程的轨道和片段
say.note: 输出工程的轨道、片段与起止时间

howto.what_en: Claude writes renderable HyperFrames video projects from HTML: declaring timing with data-* attributes, marking clips with class="clip", and following the rules for tracks, sub-compositions, variables and framework-owned media playback.
howto.when_en: Triggers before writing composition HTML, and for composition structure, data-* timing attributes, tracks and similar topics, plus validation of existing projects.

say_en.text: Start me from the minimal skeleton for a renderable HyperFrames project
say_en.note: Gives the smallest renderable composition skeleton

say_en.text: Check my index.html for lint errors and tell me how to fix them
say_en.note: Lists each lint error and its fix

say_en.text: List this project's tracks and clips with npx hyperframes timeline
say_en.note: Prints tracks, clips, starts and ends
